title: New UI Offset Transform Applies Differently Based on "Visual Only" Parameter
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb]

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 61.61 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I am using the new UI offset transform parameters to achieve a sort of pseudo-parallax effect in a menu. For this to fully work, I went ahead and marked the `offset_transform_visual_only` parameter to `false`, since I want the buttons to properly register hover input events (instead of registering them where they'd be without the offset applied).

But this causes the transform to appear choppy, as if it applies to the Control node only at certain thresholds. And it really is just the appearance; the value of `offset_transform_position_ratio` and `offset_transform_position` changes smoothly (I tried the effect with either one, just in case), it's just the visual part, the "movement" that has the choppy-ness. Moving the mouse cursor between these threshold coordinates just doesn't move the Control node, so it's not a timing issue either.

Switching `offset_transform_visual_only` back to `true` causes the movement to be smooth, correctly applying `offset_transform_position_ratio` and `offset_transform_position` to the Control node's appearance. However, for my use case, that means button input events register incorrectly (ex. hover state when cursor is visually next to the button and not over it), but that's the intended behavior. I think these transforms should apply to the node smoothly in both cases, though.

### Steps to reproduce

- Make a Control node (in the MRP I use TextureRects for visual clarity)
- Set `offset_transform_enabled` to `true` and `offset_transform_visual_only` to `false`
- Write a short script that moves the Control node based on mouse movement
- Optional: Add a button as a child of the Control node, to test hover detection

When `offset_transform_visual_only` is `false`, the Control node's movement is choppy, but when set to `true` the movement is smooth.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[ui-offset-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30639392/ui-offset-mrp.zip)
